title: AT-ViT: Area-Targeted Multi-View Vision Transformer with Cross-Attention and Multi-Scale Patching for Plant Trait Recognition in Herbarium Images
abstract: arXiv:2608.21067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated plant traits recognition from herbarium images is essential for plant sciences, yet remains challenging because background elements (e.g., textual labels, mounting artifacts, and color charts) can introduce shortcut learning, leading models to rely on spurious non-plant cues rather than plant morphology. This bias degrades both generalization and interpretability. In this paper, we introduce AT-ViT, a dual-branch Vision Transformer that jointly encodes raw herbarium scans and their segmented-derived counterparts via a multi-scale, multi-view cross-attention fusion scheme. AT-ViT further incorporates a mask-guided patch weighting mechanism that amplifies plant-relevant regions and attenuates background-driven features. translated_title: AT-ViT：面向植物标本图像性状识别的区域目标多视角视觉Transformer，结合交叉注意力与多尺度分块
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21067v1 公告类型：跨领域  摘要：从植物标本图像中自动识别植物性状对植物科学至关重要，但这一任务仍具挑战性，因为背景元素（如文本标签、装订痕迹和色卡）可能引发捷径学习，导致模型依赖非植物线索而非植物形态。这种偏差会降低泛化能力和可解释性。本文提出AT-ViT，一种双分支视觉Transformer，通过多尺度、多视角的交叉注意力融合方案，联合编码原始标本扫描图及其分割衍生图。AT-ViT还引入了掩码引导的分块加权机制，用于增强植物相关区域并抑制背景驱动特征。通过从原始扫描图学习，同时借助分割掩码进行引导，该模型被鼓励聚焦于植物器官，并学习以植物为中心的表征。
tldr: 本文提出AT-ViT，一种双分支视觉Transformer，利用多尺度交叉注意力与掩码引导分块加权机制，有效抑制背景干扰，提升植物标本图像性状识别的准确性与可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AT-ViT, a dual-branch Vision Transformer with multi-scale cross-attention and mask-guided patch weighting, which effectively suppresses background interference to improve plant trait recognition accuracy and interpretability in herbarium images.
